development_repeated_partitions.scope: Same earlier players in all partitions; not three independent replications.

profile_controls.scope: Fixed trained earlier-class model; whole held-out player profiles permuted within NFL position. No reselection. Diagnostic, not an exchangeability-certified p-value; permutations can break physical/profile dependence and availability.

team_cluster_forward.scope: Team resampling over fixed player-mean errors; model and cohort fixed.
